visual.general_description: Six-panel composite of coronary angiographic frames (A, B, C, E) and intravascular ultrasound cross-sections (D, F), each with a printed panel letter.
visual.detailed_description: A 3 by 2 grid of grayscale images with panel letters A to F printed at the lower left of each. Top row: A, a coronary angiogram with white printed "LCX" and "LAD" labels; C, a frame with a curved tubular stent-like outline and a white arrow with the printed letter "D"; E, a similar frame with a white arrow with the printed letter "F". Bottom row: B, a low-contrast frame with a faint curved tubular outline; D and F, circular intravascular ultrasound cross-sections with a central catheter marker. No names, dates, scanner text or scale are visible.

panels.general_description: Grayscale coronary angiogram with printed LCX and LAD labels.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A is a grayscale projection image of a contrast-filled coronary arterial tree. A thick dark vessel arches from the left edge toward the top, with the white printed text "LCX" near its upper end and the white printed text "LAD" beside a vessel branching below it, and thinner branches fan out toward the right. A white letter "A" is printed at the lower left. No arrows, scale or other text are visible.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Grayscale projection image with contrast-filled branching coronary vessels

evidence.quote: Selective coronary angiography revealed a long stenosis in the proximal to medial segment of the left anterior descending (LAD) artery.

evidence.quote: (A) 70%, type A lesion of medial LAD.

clinical_significance.statement: The caption describes a 70%, type A lesion of the medial LAD while the case text gives the approximately 70% stenosis for the LCX; the authors' claim is not read from pixels.

evidence.quote: (A) 70%, type A lesion of medial LAD.
The narrowest portion and medial segment of the left circumflex (LCX) artery were approximately 70% stenosed (Fig. 1A).

limitations: The stenosis and its percentage are not measurable or labelled on the image; the vessel carrying the 70% lesion is unresolved between caption and text.
Resolution is 800 by 455 pixels for the whole composite.
